purpose: A unary `!` in an HSPICE expression is refused, as HSPICE documents none.

oracle.derivation: HSPICE Quick Reference Guide U-2003.03 (cse.chalmers.se/~perla/ugrad/EDA351/HSPICEQuickRef.pdf), Algebraic Expressions: the operators are + - * / and the listed functions; there is no logical not. Xyce 7.10.0 also refuses it ("Unrecognized character: ! in expression").
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
